$comment: The repair fallback chain advances through codex (task default), codex-alt (Astra high), and claude (the existing Claude launcher). Argon is opt-in in custom chains, but its launcher remains unavailable until a confined repair adapter exists; unavailable rungs are skipped. Settings cascade from the standard default to platform fixExecutor.fallbackChain, this file, then env WE_FIX_EXECUTOR_FALLBACK_CHAIN (comma list or JSON array). ["codex","claude"] restores the pre-chain behaviour; critical work still never leaves Claude when escalating beyond the ordinary first rung.
